messages:
Maya (PM): Quick heads-up — TRI Health (enterprise pilot) asked to pull forward a compliance tokenization pilot into this quarter. They want private deployment + audit logs. Ask: start work immediately; legal expects demo in 6 weeks. Need decision by EOD tomorrow.
Devon - Eng: :eyes: capacity is tight. Our infra team is mid-dedicated rollout and two oncall rotations. Can we scope this down to an MVP?
Aj Patel (Sales): TRI is a target ACV $400k ARR if pilot goes well. Sales is pushing this — we risk losing momentum if we delay.
Ruth (CS): TRI needs tokenization + KMS integration and audit trail. They also want performance numbers for 50 req/s. Not asking for high availability day 1.
Sam G (Product Ops): We need a clear ask: what are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves. Also how does this move affect Optimize and the batching initiative in our OKRs?
Maya (PM): Proposal: tradeoff plan — pull in "compliance pilot (MVP)" by reallocating 1 FE, 2 BE engineers for 6 weeks; defer one Optimize scope item (query-caching perf tweaks) to next quarter. MVP scope: tokenization API, basic KMS hooks, audit log export. No multi-region, no dedicated SLA.
Devon - Eng: That sounds doable if we limit perf target to 50 req/s with flat tokens (no heavy long-context evals). Also need 1 engineer from infra for private deploy packaging, 3 days onboarding.
Aj Patel (Sales): If we accept MVP, I'll sign a letter of intent and ask TRI to accept a staged SLA. They can wait on multi-region.
Finance Bot: Quick calc — estimated uplift if pilot converts: $400k ARR. Cost of reallocation (3 engineers x 6 weeks): approx $36k in salary-loaded cost, plus infra ~ $4k one-time.
Ruth (CS): Operational acceptance criteria from TRI: tokenization end-to-end, logs delivered to S3, KMS key rotation demo. They don't need full RBAC day 1.
Sam G (Product Ops): Launch gating suggestions:
```
- Canary with 10% traffic to pilot config
- Success metrics: authentication + tokenization error rate < 1%, median latency < 200ms for tokenization API
- Integration checklist: KMS key exchange, S3 audit exports validated by TRI
- Rollback plan: auto-fallback to hosted model on failure
```
Maya (PM): Decision needed: Approve reallocation of 3 eng for MVP and mark Optimize - caching item as deferred. Vote: +1 to approve, -1 to decline.
Devon - Eng: +1 but request explicit list of dev tasks and timeline before we start.
Aj Patel (Sales): +1 — will get LOI signed and confirm TRI accepts MVP limitations.
Ruth (CS): +1 from CS. I'll prepare the integration checklist and coordinate TRI engineering.
Sam G (Product Ops): +1, please add canary monitoring dashboards to the plan.
Maya (PM): Great — proceeding with reallocation. Devon, I'll ping you the task list by EOD. Aj/Ruth, can you confirm LOI and technical contacts?
Aj Patel (Sales): Confirmed — sending LOI draft now.
Ruth (CS): Confirmed — TRI engineering contact is jay@trihealth.com, shared in DM.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. We'll treat this as a scoped mid-quarter OKR adjustment: moving one Optimize KR into backlog and adding pilot execution to "Customer Pilots" KR. Will update roadmap doc after LOI. :thumbsup:
